base: black-and-white editorial fine-art still-life photograph, desaturated, high contrast, fine film grain. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Immaculate, clean, minimal scene. images.scene: ONE single popped popcorn kernel, alone, resting on a smooth clean matte dark stone surface, seen from slightly above table level, macro. The popcorn is white and sharply detailed, every fold of the burst lit by hard side light; behind it the surface recedes into a very dark, almost black void so the white popcorn stands out, and the darkness lifts into pale haze towards the top. Nothing else in the frame. Museum-like stillness.

ONE single popcorn kernel photographed at the exact instant it bursts, alone in the frame, macro, frozen mid-pop: the dark shiny hull splitting open and the white starch erupting outward in sharp detail, a few tiny fragments suspended in the air around it. It floats a little above a smooth clean matte dark surface, against a very dark, almost black background so the white burst stands out; the darkness lifts into pale haze towards the top. Hard side light. Nothing else in the frame.
